stroke.termination: count and pen-up state transition; no point sentinel

invocation.r1: pointer to current finalized stroke descriptor

output.encoding: 16-bit ASCII-compatible digit code; wider character encoding unproven
output.correctness: separate exercise comparison at 0x02025728; do not include expected-answer policy in recognizer adapter
